newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel jumps five pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Piltel jumps five pct in late trade.

text.p: Cellular phone company Pilipino Telephone Corp climbed by 75 centavos, or five percent, to 15.75 pesos on a technical rebound in late trade on Monday, traders said.
"It's really just a rebound since the issue recently reached a year-low," said Spencer Yap, BPI Capital Corp research head.
Piltel last week hit a year-low due to disappointing 1996 earnings of 710.468 million pesos from an original forecast of over a billion pesos.
The company, which has been suffering from cloning problems, had a provision of 886.352 million pesos for doubtful accounts in its 1996 earnings.

"The upside of the issue is limited. And because we expect tighter credit and slower revenue flow this year due to a smaller subscriber base, we have downgraded our (1997) earnings forecast to 800 million from over a billion," said BPI's Yap.
A total of 1.54 million shares of the cellular phone firm traded late in the session.
